title: 6 · Test scenarios
description: Lines written vs lines received for each run of ./run.sh scenarios.

options.content:
`./run.sh scenarios` runs each situation below once. Every line a scenario writes says which scenario and run it belongs to and how many lines that scenario writes in total, so this dashboard can compare. **100% means every line arrived.**

| Scenario | What happens |
|---|---|
| evict-api | evicted through the Eviction API with no grace period (like a drain) |
| evict-kubelet | outgrows its ephemeral-storage limit; the kubelet evicts it |
| force-delete | deleted with --grace-period=0 --force as soon as it runs |
| short-lived | lives about a second, deleted as soon as it completes |
| oom-kill | writes its lines, then goes over its memory limit and is OOM-killed |
| crashloop | 4 pods that exit straight away; their first 3 attempts are counted |
| burst | 300,000 lines, fast enough that the kubelet rotates the log file |
| init, sidecar, stdout, stderr | the containers of one pod, one stream each |
| long-100k, long-400k, after-long | a 100 KB line, a 400 KB line (Loki keeps the first 256 KB) and 50 lines after them |

panels.title: Delivered
panels.description: Lines received as a share of lines written.

targets.expr: sum by (run, scenario) (count_over_time({cluster="$cluster", namespace="scenarios"} | logfmt | keep scenario, run, expected | scenario!="" | run=~".*$run.*" [$__range])) / max by (run, scenario) (max_over_time({cluster="$cluster", namespace="scenarios"} | logfmt | keep scenario, run, expected | scenario!="" | run=~".*$run.*" | unwrap expected | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.description: How many of each scenario's lines are in Loki.

targets.expr: sum by (run, scenario) (count_over_time({cluster="$cluster", namespace="scenarios"} | logfmt | keep scenario, run, expected | scenario!="" | run=~".*$run.*" [$__range]))

panels.title: Why each scenario pod ended (pod-lifecycle watcher)
panels.description: Evicted, OOMKilled, EvictionByEvictionAPI, Error: one record per change.

targets.expr: {cluster="$cluster", namespace="logging", container="watch"} | json pod_name="pod", ns="namespace", lifecycle="lifecycle", phase="phase", reason="reason", msg="message", disruption="disruption.reason", cname="containers[0].name", creason="containers[0].reason", exit="containers[0].exitCode", last="containers[0].lastLines" | ns="scenarios" | phase="Failed" or lifecycle="DELETED" or disruption!="" | line_format "{{.pod_name}}  {{.lifecycle}}  phase={{.phase}}  reason={{.reason}}  disruption={{.disruption}}  container {{.creason}} exit={{.exit}}"
